## Purpose
The dialog for creating an agent by hand: name, description, instructions, model and rules (with suggestions).

## Responsibilities
- `CreateAgentModal({open, onCreate})` uses `ModelPicker`, opening on the configured default (which may arrive after the first render).
- `RuleSelector`, with `rulesApi.suggest`.
